mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the past month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts by more than 10% in the past two months signals a decline in demand for new homes, which is a leading indicator of a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST decreases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in the past two months signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity and potential corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) over the past three months, coupled with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate, indicates strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% in 3 months AND UNRATE stable or decrease
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% and UNRATE is stable or decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in the past month, coupled with a stable or decreasing federal funds rate, indicates a strong labor market and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS stable or decrease
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and FEDFUNDS is stable or decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in GDP, indicated by GDPC1 growing by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, signals strong economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to grow.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the quarters when GDPC1 grows by more than 2%.
